obligations.source_text: Use the attached portrait as a bounded makeup reference and test the same observable makeup contract inside an unrelated nocturnal pollination-archive scene.

bindings.complexion_phrase: sheer-to-light satin complexion correction leaves fine skin texture and natural tonal variation readable
bindings.brow_phrase: softly groomed low-arch brows retain individual hairs
bindings.eye_gradient_phrase: a neutral taupe wash is deepest at the upper lash line and diffuses through the crease
bindings.liner_phrase: a slim interlash line ends in a very short tapered outer extension
bindings.cheek_phrase: a muted rose flush stays soft on the cheeks
bindings.lip_phrase: muted rosy-coral lip color is strongest near the inner center, fades toward a softly diffused vermilion edge, and carries a low satin-balm sheen
bindings.hierarchy_phrase: Eye, cheek, and lip contrast remain mutually restrained so the complexion leads the hierarchy
